notes.title: A Better "HD" Version
notes.content:
This is the first major update after releasing Football Drama "HD". It features a major improvement: the readability of all texts that are now "sharper", in particular texts that are not black or white. 

Another nice new feature is the hints for the controller mapping:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/21b89b5f3818a1e1454061c79f77c67a4eee6641.gif

In the meantime, Football Drama has gone through  Nintendo certification for the Nintendo Switch (coming out this week!), and this led to fixing several minor bugs:

 Several fixes to localization (German, Russian, Chinese).
 More robust to random tapping.

You also will find more variety in press meetings. Remember the new auto speed up option in settings!

P.S. Also with 40% discount until the 5th of May!

notes.title: Football Drama “HD” — Major Update Released!
notes.content:
You can now update Football Drama and get a full-featured version built for desktops: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/1143d797a4ec5153d1ac6f3a48e9577823ebb383.gif

This is a big update for desktop users, as with this the entire application layouts have been redesigned to use the whole landscape mode space. We hope you’ll appreciate the new layouts! 

Moreover, you can play with a controller (or even keyboard):

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/ba01ae61421dcbcc87aef0dd3474715032cca257.png

This release also includes several feature updates.

One nice new feature that we found can improve a lot the gameplay experience for some players is the “sped up mode”, available in Settings, that speeds up the matches gameplay so that the flow from deciding between a cautious and a risky move is quicker. This option also removes the enter fields animations and the replays after the first championship week.

We have a new “night mode” - some matches are played in the evenings. We also introduced some post-processing for the graphics of the whole application, and you can see both effects in action here:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/3044bababc4864dbf80041b143647d5ea6f5be2d.gif

There also some bug fixes and a new badge, that you may get when you meet a journalist and the major plot is revealed...
A reference to periodical football corruption scandals that are one of the distinguishing features of this sport.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/25156622832dda9ca852930029e28460bb1c8323.jpg

(By the way here is the custom achievement site that we've built for Football Drama.)

And the future? We are now building a content expansion update (first quarter 2021), together with a Japanese language version and Nintendo Switch release. All this will be a free update for Steam users.

Last but not least, Steam Winter Sale is coming...

notes.title: Some Good Reasons To Buy Football Drama Now
notes.content:
Football Drama currently is in a “weeklong deal” on Steam (60% discount, which is the highest you’ll ever get), and soon there will be 2020’s Steam Autumn and Winter sales. Plus Itch.io’s “black friday”.  It’s probably not a bad idea to get it now discounted because of three coming updates:


 A feature update (December 2020)
 The “HD” version for Steam and desktops in general (we hope also December 2020)
 The content expansion update (first quarter 2021), together with Japanese language version and Nintendo Switch release.


Feature update
One nice new feature that we found can improve a lot the gameplay experience for some players is the “sped up mode”, available in Settings, that speeds up the matches gameplay so that the flow from deciding between a cautious and a risky move is quicker. This option also removes the enter fields animations and the replays.

We have a new “night mode” - some matches are played in the evenings. We also introduced some post-processing for the graphics of the whole application, and you can see both effects in action here:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/b92b801edeb331c9940322815ecc7f4cafe833ff.gif

There also some bug fixes and a new badge.

HD version with controller & keyboard support
This is a big update for desktop users, as with this the entire application layouts have been redesigned to use the whole landscape mode space. Together with this, we introduced controller (and keyboard) support, and that is a really nice way to play matches.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/95c9f049e36ecb484743c703408e6caca695c391.gif

Content expansion update
We are writing and developing an expansion of Football Drama’s narrative, both in the sheer number of dialogues and in variety of contents for looping events (e.g. meeting the press). Moreover, there will also be a Japanese localized version, and a Nintendo Switch porting.

All these will of course be free updates!

notes.title: Winter (Sale) Is Coming: Three Months Of (Football) Drama And The Future
notes.content:
We recap three months of sales and preview Football Drama expansions: "HD" version, Switch porting, expanded narrative, Japanese localization.

We released Football Drama on September 18, releasing on Steam and mobile. We sold over 6000 units up to now, we have a constant stream of sales, and we got some very nice press ːsteamhappyː

We are happy to put it in this Winter Sale, and on the 23rd of December we will also publish a free demo of the mobile version on iOS (full iOS version here).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/f81e896cdd0fb06a9654b81ca0afc171839b0d4b.jpg

Here is one of our favourite interviews, at Indiecade Europe this year:
[previewyoutube=9PbjoDzvPgI;full][/previewyoutube]
and here are links to two nice reviews, at Kotaku  and Rock Paper Shotgun. In Italian we have even been featured on several paper magazines!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/ba780bd2dfd165953a70c423692b36fc8d58d17a.jpg

Where are we going? 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/0acda10fb08815bf92a9fbb542f4e14deb8b33a7.jpg

We are developing an "HD" version that will serve several purposes: 

(1) will be released on Switch, 

(2) will be an update of the Steam/desktop version and 

(3) we hope to include also accessibility features (maybe an audio-only version). 

So you will get a version of Football Drama (a free update) that will use the full screen and an extension of the narrative.

Yes, the Switch release will have some special content, which will be eventually certainly released also for the other platforms later on, and also a Japanese localization.

A new game? Yes indeed: we are developing a prototype of our next game, Roller Drama...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/33bbd7c55f505799338044f7ce5e78808cebc40c.jpg

notes.title: Match Card Analysis, Shameless Pundits, Slo-mo Replays...
notes.content:
This update is "major" because we improved several aspects of the game also in consequence of the feedback received.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/27d80753753d23eafa81ca48459a8803872ea5d4.jpg

The main updates are:

 After every training and for each successful card played, you get detailed feedback about your team's state compared with your current opponent. This is something several players requested. This reveals a lot of background, so we tried to make it so that it does not "break the magic" of how matches go.

 We introduced more variations in the narrative (e.g. press meetings), with more integration between matches and Rocco's life, and removed some end of match loops ("handshakegate") after the first championship weeks.


Other improvements:

 Action replays improved a lot; moreover, you can close replays way sooner just by tapping on them.
 Improved the AI on some match actions.
 Minor font size issues in non-English versions.


Specifically for the mobile version: if you play it on a high-resolution tablet, you can play it in landscape mode, getting the additional features available on HD layouts (Football Drama is also available on iOS  and Android).

And finally, the Autumn Steam sale should go live really really soon... :-)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/98ec36a71bbcd293ac2f37b576304b8d51a18840.jpg

notes.title: First Football Drama Update: Speed Up!
notes.content:
So we just went live with our first Football Drama update. 

We are sorry for the two bugs, they would not have occurred if we had a cross platform cross language testing team, but being two guys that try to do everything (marketing and support too) we do what we can. So THANKS for the users who reported them in detail so we could fix them. 
Football Drama is also doing very well on mobile, on App Store (iOS) and Google Play (Android), thanks for that too.

These are the improvements/changes/fixes:

 We added a tutorial step in the second half to tell about the "tap or click in the field centre" just after you made a choice in the match that speeds up the whole thing. For players that like faster matches, it changes the whole feeling of the game.
 We removed the (sometimes repetitive) meeting with the president when nothing crucial is happening (i.e. he is not furious, you are not fired, you didn't win the championship). This too seems a small change but makes the whole flow more natural.
 We did a lot of improvements in the translation, in particular in French (Charlene Lebrun), Italian (Luca Papale), Chinese (Melanie Luo), Russian.
 BUG FIX: We fixed a bug in the rendering of the German and Russian Oracle dialogue that crashed the game.
 BUG FIX: There was an occasional problem in saving the state of matches (not involving you) of the current week.

So we hope you enjoy the game even more \o/

notes.title: Football Drama's Modding Plan
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228816/916b9c659c0edbca4d5645c8485865955f449cb5.png

So I got this email yesterday from a beta tester friend and I know he is a great supporter and expert of Napoli FC. So I thought "Pity that there are no Napoli references in Football Drama" and then "It's so easy to change teams because all the configurations are not hard coded" and then "Wow its all already built for... modding!".

So then I woke up with the full plan: in the game first development patch after release (after the inevitable first release day patches of panic) I will add (only for desktop versions) a check at startup for a folder of customizations - if enough people ask for it.

You will be able to mod all the team's features, and also the commentary, and even the set of cards and their consequences! Because it is all in CSV files.
Together with that, I will need to add in the app settings:
- Show the mod's folder path.
- Enable a "no personal narrative" mode so that the narrative will focus on the championship and the surrounding narrative events (meeting the other coach, president and press).

All this is actually feasible because of how Football Drama has been built in order to make it easy to test & debug.

"A mod (short for "modification") is an alteration by players or fans of a video game[1] that changes one or more aspects of a video game, such as how it looks or behaves. Mods may range from small changes and tweaks to complete overhauls, and can extend the replay value and interest of the game." Wikipedia.
